difficulty_definitions.medium: Comparison, calculation, units, adjustments, or guidance distinction.
difficulty_definitions.hard: Contextual follow-ups, unanswerable questions, or forbidden-company requests.

scoring_policy.retrieval: Score answerable and follow_up cases only; use pre-citation top-K retrieval results, not displayed sources. Break down by company and difficulty and show denominators.

scoring_policy.negative_cases: Unanswerable: abstention and no displayed sources. Denied: denial, no retrieval/model answer, no sources. Exclude both from retrieval denominators.
scoring_policy.follow_ups: Use supplied gold history for isolated rewrite/RAG evaluation. For end-to-end sessions, execute earlier user turns and score generated histories separately. Use fresh session IDs per case.
scoring_policy.tuning: This is a development validation set, not an untouched test benchmark. Do not report tuning-set performance as generalization.
